파우치도 너무 갖고싶었는데,,  파우치속에 쏙 들어가서 가지고 다니기 좋겠어요! 사이즈확인하려고 착용해봤는데 딱이에요! 애카가서 놀다가 잘 벗겨지는건 아닌지 모르겠지만 사이즈면으로는 매우 만족입니다!!!!
reviews.content_en: My pup has a 28cm waist. I've used medium for other products. The packaging is smaller than other mannered belts so I was worried at first lol But since it's compact, it'll be so convenient to carry around. Other wider belts covered my dog's entire waist which seemed uncomfortable, but this one doesn't, so I love it. I really wanted the pouch too,, and it fits perfectly inside so it's great to carry around! I tried it on to check the size and it's perfect! I'm not sure if it comes off easily when she plays at the dog cafe, but I'm very satisfied with the sizing!!!!

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content: 침대에 쉬야를 많이 해서 하루에 침대 위 매트 3개를 세탁한 적도 있고, 침대에 올려놓긴 걱정인데 또 안 올려주자니 쿵쿵 거리며 점프를 하는데 아직 아기라 다리에 무리가 갈까봐 올려주게 되더라구요. 최근에 30분 정도는 기저귀를 채워서 올려준 후 쉬하면 풀어주고 있었는데 초소형인데도 사이즈가 인 맞아서 기저귀를 물고 빙글빙글 돌았었어요. 근데 이건 튼튼하게 잡아주면서 사이즈에 맞게 딱 고정이 되더라구요 편하게 누워서 잠도 자요. 쉬 하면 바로 체크할 수 있어서 좋고 매너벨트 필수인 카페나 유치원 갈 때도 좋을 것 같아요!
reviews.content_en: My pup pees on the bed a lot so I've had to wash 3 bed mats in a day sometimes, and I'm worried about putting them on the bed but if I don't, she jumps around making noise, and since she's still a baby I was worried about strain on her legs so I end up putting them on. Recently I've been putting the diaper on for about 30 minutes, then letting her go pee and removing it, but even though it's extra small, the sizing was so perfect that she'd grab the diaper and spin around in circles. But this one holds firmly while fitting perfectly to the size, and she lies down comfortably and sleeps. It's good that I can check right away when she pees, and it seems like it'll be great for cafes and daycares that require mannered belts!

reviews.content_en: Our pup Mitzu usually hates and finds mannered belts uncomfortable, but she's so comfortable with BOSUM diapers!! Even lying flat ㅠㅠ 🖤 3.8kg Pomeranian and M size fits well! Now I can go to daycare and cafes without worry so comfortably! : ) At home she does her business well but outside I'm always worried she'll have accidents so I always carry a mannered belt, but she was uncomfortable with them which was a worry. Fortunately BOSUM diapers don't itch and she moves around well so I'll use them often!!

reviews.content:

reviews.content_en: 1.8kg Bandal boy 🐶 An essential item for Bandal who goes to dog cafes frequently. Really really great. When Bandal wears a diaper her walking becomes unnatural so she doesn't play much, but with BITE ME diapers she doesn't seem bothered at all and plays well! Several people asked me which brand it was when they saw Bandal wearing a diaper hehe For small kids I think getting S size without worrying about sizing would be good. The diaper attachment part doesn't get pilling even after removing and reattaching several times so it stays cleaner longer. Regarding absorption, Bandal doesn't mark much, so I poured water on it and it absorbed a large amount of liquid, so no problems! Now BITE ME is my final choice for Bandal's diapers ♡

reviews.content_en: 15 years old / Male / Weight 3.5kg / Chest circumference 38cm / Waist circumference 32cm approximately. Normally a free-spirited pup, but we consistently go camping seasonally and occasionally visit shopping malls, dog-friendly cafes and restaurants, so I use it sometimes but I still feel better having stock, so I bought it when they had a sale~ The circumference is quite generous so even if my dog is bigger, I think it can be used sufficiently! The velcro part is about the size of a small palm?! It's long enough with room so you can consider the size generously! As you can see in review videos, the pad part that absorbs pee is thick so even dogs that pee a lot won't leak easily! For the price, the quality is really good~ 👍👍👍
